dead_or_keyed.name: Reddit r/BurningMan

tests.note: 403 with browser UA AND with custom UA
budget exhausted after a SINGLE request

dead_or_keyed.vercel_note: Worse on Vercel, not better: serverless egress comes from shared cloud IP ranges that Reddit throttles far more aggressively than residential IPs.
dead_or_keyed.only_supported_path: OAuth via https://oauth.reddit.com (script app, client credentials, descriptive User-Agent, ~100 QPM)
dead_or_keyed.recommendation: drop from the design unless you are willing to register an app and store credentials

dead_or_keyed.name: X / Twitter @bmantraffic (free routes)
dead_or_keyed.reason: no free route returns current posts

tests.note: 200 with a ZERO-BYTE body; retried with &dnt=true, same. Endpoint retired.

TRAP. Returns parseable __NEXT_DATA__ with 100 tweets, but date range is 2017-08-23 to 2025-08-26. Year histogram: {2023:67, 2022:10, 2019:6, 2025:6, 2018:5, 2024:5, 2017:1}. ZERO posts from 2026. Dominated by 2023 mudpocalypse 'Do not travel to Black Rock City!' notices. Polling this would render 3-year-old emergency closures as today's gate status.

DOES work and returns current data (verified against the live 14:53:04Z '20 minutes' post), but requires knowing the tweet id in advance — and the only free source of current ids is /api/feed/public, which already gives you the text. Circular; no added value.

dead_or_keyed.conclusion: BM's own /api/feed/public is the ONLY free live mirror of @bmantraffic. Anything else needs a paid X API tier (~$200/mo Basic). Treat the feed as a single point of failure and show 'unavailable' on error rather than substituting a stale mirror.

mirror BM's own *_visibility flags and the feeds health map
